artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 8.7 x 5.7 cm (3 7/16 x 2 1/4 in.)
support: 16 x 12.7 cm (6 5/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The drawing depicts a central figure, raised on a cloud, with arms outstretched and garments flowing. Surrounding this figure are other figures, some appearing to float nearby. The lower portion of the image shows a group of figures positioned on the ground gazing upward, with various postures that suggest reverence or awe. The drawing displays intricate linework, capturing a sense of dynamic movement and illustrating clouds, garments, and figures with detailed attention.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted from the back, with her entire form visible except for the far edge of her lower body. She is standing in front of a table with her arms raised, holding a large feathered hat. Her hair is styled up and she is wearing a long, fitted dress with puffed sleeves. On the table, two hats adorned with feathers are seen along with a hat box. The background is plain and monochrome.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a menu. It features a stylized depiction of a menu written in French, listing food items and beverages. A line drawing on the right shows a figure appearing to engage with a decorative element resembling a plant or floral arrangement. Below the menu, there is a round basket or hatbox. The background is minimalistic with fluid lines.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green
artworks.description: A woman placing a feathered hat on a display stand next to a printed but handwritten menu is printed shades of sage green on cream-colored paper in this vertical lithograph. The woman and menu are surrounded by a wide margin on all sides. The woman faces our left in profile. Her hair is pulled up and back. Her short jacket has sleeves puffed at the shoulders and tight along the arms. A skirt falls straight from her narrow waist. She stands on one side of a wide counter that holds two hat stands, and an oval-shaped hat box sits behind her feet. The woman’s body, features, clothing, and the objects around her are outlined with darker sage green. In the lower left corner, the menu reads as follows: “menu, Potages, St Germain Perles du Japon, Hors d’oeuvres, Radis Saucisson crevettes, Olives Buerre, Poisson, Fillets de Barbeu dieppoise legumes. Haricots verts maître d’hotel, petits pois bonne femme, Rots, Dindonneau au cresson, Salade, entremets Rocher de glace, Desserts assortis. Vins. Bordeaux. Champagne. Café. Cognac. On se mettra a table à 8 heures.” The bottom right corner of the printed image is stamped with a round, pale-green mark that combines the letters H, T, and L in a circle. A faint inscription in graphite in the lower left corner of the page is difficult to make out.

artworks.title: The Hairdresser - Program for the Théâtre Libre (Le coiffeur - Programme du Théâtre Libre)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black, yellow, and red
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a seated woman and another woman standing behind her. The seated woman is depicted from the side and slightly from behind, with long, flowing blonde hair and subtle facial features. She is holding an oval-shaped hand mirror in her right hand and wearing a loose-fitting garment. The standing woman has short hair pulled upward and is wearing a loose robe with vertical stripes. She is shown combing or styling the seated woman's hair. The background consists of a textured surface with vertical lines.

artworks.title: The Hairdresser - Program for the Theatre-Libre (Le coiffeur - Programme du Théatre-Libre)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black, yellow, and red
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an upper-body portrayal. The person in the foreground is seated, holding a mirror in their left hand. They have long golden hair, red lips, and a serene expression. The person behind is combing the seated person's hair. It shows text in French related to theatre programs in the background.

artworks.title: Les Vieilles Histoires (cover/frontispiece)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bear being led by a chain held by a person in a top hat and coat. The background features a stylized landscape with a prominent bridge and a distant cityscape. The dominant colors are subtle pastels with emphasis on earthy tones for the bear and deeper colors for the figure's attire. The text "Les Vieilles Histoires" along with additional text about "Poesies de Jean Goudezki" is present on the artwork. This painting is in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, known for distinctive outlines and flat planes of color in his posters and illustrations.

artworks.title: For You (Pour toi!...)
artworks.medium: 4-color lithograph on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from the side in a slightly hunched position. The person has short hair, a pronounced nose, and a mustache, wearing a dark suit with a white collar. They hold a long object. Behind them is a figure resembling a devil or demon, with horns and a smile. The background has swirling patterns with light and dark colors.

artworks.title: For You (Pour toi!...)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man from the waist up, seated with an object in hand. The man faces slightly to the left with an upright posture, his head turned left. He has a prominent nose, mustache, and a serious expression, with short, combed-back hair. He wears a dark suit against a pale background. In the background is a sketch of a sculpture or fantastical creature with horn-like protrusions. The background features swirling lines and textures, possibly depicting clouds or abstract elements, with tree-like forms in the distance.

artworks.title: For You (Pour toi!...)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man seated, looking to the right. He has distinctive features including a mustache and slicked-back hair, wearing a dark outfit. The man is holding a long object in his right hand. Beside him, there is a horned figure. The background is abstract with elements resembling a cloudy sky and rough lines.

artworks.title: Sleepless Night (Nuit blanche)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image features a man's upper body in profile, facing left. He has a prominent nose, mustache, and beard. His hair is short and dark. He wears a dark coat against a dark background. The scene has minimalistic elements, with abstract vertical lines hinting at trees or fencing. The backdrop suggests an outdoor setting with a speckled sky texture. The focus is on the man's silhouette against the simple background.

artworks.title: Sleepless Night (Nuit blanche)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile view of a man. He is sitting facing left, looking upwards. The man has a notable nose, mustache, and beard. He has medium-length dark hair. He wears a dark textured jacket that matches the background. Nothing is held in his hands. The background is abstract with a crescent moon, tree-like silhouettes, clouds, and a tree shape on the left. The image is monochrome, resembling a sketch.

artworks.title: Your Mouth (Ta bouche)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in bed, with only their upper body and head visible. The person is in a side sleeping position with their head resting on their arms, which are on or above a pillow. Their facial features are outlined, with closed eyes and a peaceful expression. They have short, dark hair and are covered with a blanket or sheet. Next to the person is a bedside table with a rounded object, possibly a candlestick or plant. The background includes a bed headboard and soft lines suggesting bedding. The image is in a monochromatic sepia tone.

artworks.title: Your Mouth (Ta bouche)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on a bed in a side position from head to waist. The person has a peaceful expression with closed eyes and dark, neat hair. They are covered by a blanket and resting one arm on a pillow. A bedside table with a candleholder is visible to the left, and the background outlines the bed's pillows and quilted pattern. The image has a monochromatic and serene aesthetic.

artworks.title: Wisdom (Sagesse)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated. The person on the left is a man with a bald head and minimal facial features, dressed in a dark suit and bow tie. He is holding something near his chest. Opposite him is a female figure with blonde hair styled in an updo. She is facing away from the viewer, wearing a light-colored top or dress with puffed sleeves. The setting includes a high-backed chair and a decorative lamp stand with a stylized floral-shaped shade. The background is textured with an abstract motif, and the word "sagesse" is written above.

artworks.title: Wisdom (Sagesse)
artworks.medium: 5-color lithograph
artworks.description: The image displays the upper halves of two people. On the left, there is a bald man wearing a formal black suit gesturing with one hand. Behind him, there is a wall with the word "sagesse" written on it. The person on the right has reddish hair styled in an updo and is wearing a green dress with puffed sleeves. Their chair is visible, with a curved design on the back of the seat. In the background, there is a tall, yellowish flame-like shape mounted on a thin post. The surrounding area is illustrated with a stippled texture.

artworks.title: Last Ballad (Ultime ballade)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black and yellow on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure depicted in a sitting position, partially turning away from the viewer, with only the upper half of the body visible. The person is wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat that obscures the facial features. The person is dressed in a long, dark coat or cloak, set against a textured background. A distinct black and white contrast dominates the scene, with a winding white line cutting across the image. In the lower right corner, a small, bright yellow arc stands out. The background is abstract, with what may be a railing or fence to the right, and dark, vertical lines suggestive of poles or trees on the left. The overall composition has an expressive quality, focusing more on shapes and contrasts than on detailed rendering.

artworks.title: Last Ballad (Ultime ballade)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person viewed from the back, revealing their upper body. The person is sitting with their head turned slightly to the left and wearing a wide-brimmed hat with short hair visible underneath. They are wearing a dark coat with angular lines and a high collar that partially covers their neck. The background appears abstract, with vertical lines hinting at structures or a cityscape.

artworks.title: Study of a Woman (Etude de femme)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image depicts a line drawing of a nude person seen from the back, seated sideways on the edge of a surface like a bed. The person's body is fully visible from head to lower legs, with legs slightly bent and their right arm resting on the lap. The face is in profile facing left, with basic features like the nose and chin visible. The hair is curly and tied back with a ribbon. No clothing is shown, but there are hints of bedding or fabric around the person. The background has abstract lines outlining a room with basic details like a door and walls, on a textured surface. A signature is present in the lower left corner, indicating the artist.

artworks.title: Sick Carnot! (Carnot malade!)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of two figures in close proximity. The person on the left is lying in bed, covered by a blanket, only showing their head and shoulders. This figure has a unique facial feature; their head is depicted with the ears and features of a donkey, including a beard, and they are lying back against a pillow with closed eyes. The second figure, positioned to the right, is sitting or standing next to the bed, with their full upper body visible, wearing a dark jacket and a light-colored shirt. This person has a bald head and a neutral expression, holding a small dish or bowl in one hand while pointing at themselves with the other. The bed's blanket shows swirling patterns, and there is a piece of paper with illegible text visible on it. In the foreground to the left, there is a small bedside table with a candle holder on it. The background appears to be a textured wall or curtain with no distinct details.
